title: Model introduction campaign binder: sequencing, notes, and cross-team launch checklist
creator: Sofia Ramos
description: Purpose: Create a single, shareable campaign binder for a new model addition to the Redwood catalog that sequences all cross-functional work: benchmarks, catalog metadata, API/SDK examples, release notes, docs, comms, and post-launch monitoring. Goal is a predictable, repeatable launch that balances time-to-market with minimum quality guardrails. This ticket produces the canonical launch checklist, a release-notes template pre-filled with model-specific fields, a small canonical benchmark suite (latency, token throughput, accuracy on core prompt sets), and a comms timeline mapped to deliverables. Out-of-scope: deep research eval sweeps, new model architecture tuning, or pricing strategy changes beyond catalog listing notes.
checklist: Finalize model metadata for catalog (display name, short description, alias, recommended sequence lengths)
Curate canonical benchmark set: latency p50/p95, tokens/sec, and 3 prompt-based quality checks (summarization, instruction-following, safety edge cases)
Run smoke perf tests on hosted and dedicated config; capture kernel/quantization notes for runtime team
Prepare API examples: generation, chat, and embeddings snippets in JS and Python; include streaming sample
Draft release notes using template: TL;DR, breaking changes, migration tips, known limitations
Design docs audit: update model catalog page, add migration FAQ, add recommended decoder settings
Coordinate design assets: model card hero image, benchmark graphs, and copy approval
Plan announcement cadence: internal docs -> beta customers -> community blog + changelog + tweet thread
Create observability dashboard snapshot and alert runbook for post-launch regressions
Define rollback criteria and automated fallback mappings to alternate model variants
Schedule final cross-functional sign-off meeting (PM, Eng, Design, Research, Support)
